remediations.remediation_action: Bind ODP_PRODUCTION_WATCH_CLOSEOUT_URI on the GitHub 'staging' environment to the GCS URI of the production watch-window receipt. remediations.authority_note: This preflight does not set GitHub variables; the owning task does.

depends_on_producer.note: The URI names a receipt produced by the production watch window, so the value cannot be finalised before that producer exists. Bind it as part of the staging release path once the producer URI is known.

remediations.observation: FAIL: both bucket variables are unset in the staging environment. The separation guard at .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml:1207-1212 (and again at :1477-1481 for closeout) refuses when they are equal, and the `: "${VAR:?}"` guards immediately above refuse when either is empty, so the staging path cannot start. Separation cannot be satisfied by two empty values.
remediations.remediation_action: Provision two distinct GCS buckets -- one for the ephemeral staging Terraform backend and one for recovery bundles -- and bind both. They must not be the same bucket: the recovery bundle is what remains readable when the Terraform state is lost.
remediations.authority_note: Bucket creation is a mutation; this read-only preflight deliberately skipped it (CHK-GCP-BUCKET-PROVISION-STATE / -RECOVERY).

remediations.diagnosis: The probe addressed a secret name no environment binds, so its PERMISSION_DENIED cannot verify or refute the dev OIDC client-secret binding. The observation is retained unchanged; only its interpretation is corrected.
remediations.remediation_action: No new probe is required. All three environments set ODP_AUTH_MODE=local, so OIDC_REQUIRED_SECRET_REFERENCES is never evaluated and the OIDC client secret is not_applicable. If and when an environment moves to ODP_AUTH_MODE=oidc, read back the bound name oday-dev-web-oidc-client-secret rather than the probed one.
remediations.follow_up_readback: gcloud --quiet secrets describe oday-dev-web-oidc-client-secret --project=odayplus-runtime-20260825 --format=json   # only if ODP_AUTH_MODE is ever set to 'oidc'
remediations.authority_note: Recorded as an evidence-scoping correction, not as a deployment blocker.
